canon.note: Basic What Are You Looking At? (101301): Ice DMG #1 = 140% of ATK at L10 to one enemy (engine default Basic Lv6 = 100%). Skill One-Time Offer (101302): Ice DMG #1 = 100% of ATK to all enemies over 2 hits 30/70; if the target's HP% is #2 = 50% or higher, DMG against it increases by #3 = 20%, and Bonus Ability Efficiency adds a further 25% (engine total 145% before split). Ultimate It's Magic, I Added Some Magic (101303): Ice DMG #1 = 200% of ATK to all enemies. Talent Fine, I'll Do It Myself (101304): when an ally attack causes an enemy's HP% to fall to #1 = 50% or lower, Herta launches a Follow-Up ATK dealing #2 = 40% of ATK Ice DMG to all enemies (engine also grants +5 Energy per trigger). Energy limit sp_need = 110.

fixtures.env: Herta E0 solo vs 1 Ice-weak Elite dummy (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness) that stays above 50% HP, 3 cycles, seed 7
Herta E0 solo vs 1 Ice-weak Elite dummy (Lv120, 8000 HP, 300 Toughness) that drops below 50% HP early, 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Basic ATK What Are You Looking At? (101301, Ice) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
One-Time Offer (101302) is Herta's damaging Skill action.
It's Magic, I Added Some Magic (101303) executes as a standard-Energy Ultimate once the 110-Energy ladder fills.
One-Time Offer is dealt in 2 hits per cast (101302 notes, 30%+70%); over 4 Skill casts the solo fixture fires 8 hits.
While every enemy stays above 50% HP the Talent never triggers, so no Fine, I'll Do It Myself Follow-Up hit appears.
Herta's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; it never falls back to a generic attack action.
One-Time Offer L10 vs an enemy at >=50% HP: base #1 = 100% + #3 = 20% boost + Efficiency's extra 25% = 145% of ATK, dealt over 30%+70% (first hit 0.435).
Once the enemy falls below 50% HP the conditional boost disappears and One-Time Offer deals the plain L10 100% split 30/70 (first hit 0.3); the low-HP fixture records 2 such boosted-off casts.
It's Magic, I Added Some Magic L10 deals Ice DMG equal to 200% of ATK (101303 #1) in a single hit per target.

of.label: It's Magic, I Added Some Magic

requirements.claim: What Are You Looking At? runs the 50%->140% ladder (101301 #1); at the engine's default Basic Lv6 it totals 100% (mult 1.0).
Herta's Ultimate uses the standard 110-Energy ladder (sp_need 110); over this fixture her action set regenerates exactly 165 Energy.
Herta's Ultimate uses the standard 110-Energy ladder (sp_need 110); over this fixture her action set plus Talent triggers regenerates exactly 165 Energy.
The enemy's HP crosses the 50% threshold during One-Time Offer damage, and the Talent Follow-Up fires after that damage resolves.
When an ally attack drops the enemy to <=50% HP, Talent 101304 launches Fine, I'll Do It Myself as a Follow-Up ATK against all enemies.
The Follow-Up ATK deals Ice DMG equal to #2 = 40% of Herta's ATK at Talent L10 (101304).
Each qualifying attack fires at most one Follow-Up sequence; over the 4 qualifying attacks in the low-HP fixture the Talent fires exactly 3 times (the 4th Skill kills the dummy).
